_schema.description: SIDs deliberately excluded from the USF pipeline. The pipeline (build_from_usf, write_usf) refuses to process listed paths with a clear error pointing back here.

entry_fields.path: SID path relative to repo root (e.g. 'hvsc84/MUSICIANS/...')
entry_fields.reason: Why this SID is excluded — specific enough that future readers understand the call without re-investigating

_schema.adding_an_entry: Append to `entries`. Re-run `tools/build_sid_db.py` to refresh the `excluded`/`exclusion_reason` columns in hvsc84.db.

entries.reason: Companion/Jay_Derrett engine — aperiodic by design. The engine's $E0..$E9 self-mod counter + per-voice ptr drift means voices never simultaneously realign; the song is conceptually infinite. HVSC songlength is a curator-chosen cut-off, not an engine loop point. Cannot fit into the principled USF representation without dragging engine-mechanism bookkeeping (sub-jump table + initial state) into the schema.
